gloss: 不利的 · 有害的 · 相反的

scene.main: 顺风行驶的船突然被一阵逆风顶住帆，速度一下子掉了下来
scene.sub: ad-（朝向）+ vers（转）→ 风转过来对着你吹：不利的、有害的。

collocations.meaning: 不良影响（药物 · 政策）

examples.en: Patients who stopped taking the drug reported no {{w}} effects.
examples.cn: 停药的患者报告没有出现不良反应。

examples.en: Farmers suffered heavy losses after weeks of {{w}} weather.
examples.cn: 数周的恶劣天气之后，农民损失惨重。

examples.en: Children from {{w}} backgrounds are more likely to drop out of school.
examples.cn: 来自不利背景的孩子更容易辍学。

examples.en: The new policy may have {{w}} consequences for small businesses.
examples.cn: 新政策可能给小企业带来不利后果。

pitfalls.text: adverse 与 averse 只差一个字母：adverse 修饰事物，averse 表示人“厌恶的”。
表示“对…不利”时用 be adverse to + 事物，不用 adverse for。
adversity 是“逆境”，表示“对手”要用 adversary，别把两个名词混用。
pitfalls.wrong: His main adversity is the champion.
pitfalls.right: His main adversary is the champion.

rows: 修饰事物：不利的、有害的
人做主语：厌恶的、反对的
compare.chant: 物 adverse，人 averse；影响 adverse，反感 averse。

fills.sentence: The drug may cause ___ reactions in some patients.
Crops failed after a season of ___ weather.
She is not ___ to working late.
He overcame ___ and finished his degree.
Export earnings were ___ affected by the tariffs.

review: 说出 adverse 的 3 个搭配
区分 adverse / averse 各造 1 句
默写 vers 词族 8 个词
遮住释义，复述逆风顶帆的画面
writeSample: Lack of sleep has adverse effects on memory and mood.
